figurative_meaning_en: An ugly-looking person; a specific insult
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই বানরমুখো যে সবাই তাকে দেখে হাসে।
তোমার বানরমুখো ভাইকে আর এখানে আনো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so monkey-faced that everyone laughs when they see him.
Don't bring your monkey-faced brother here anymore.
note: This idiom uses animal imagery common in Bengali slang for mocking appearance.
